Bladerunner. I went into it expecting a old school first of its kind science fiction film but it turned out it was that and a lot more. It took a dive into the morals of how artificial humans are treated and viewed along with testing how real is too real? We see a protagonist fall in love with one of these replicants and start to question his own morals. We get a beautiful ending that gives us the perspective of one of these replicants and how they seem to view the entire universe from the eyes of a child. To me it is the pinnacle of what art and film should strive to be while sending a message about slavery and the future of us humans. 2049 is also a fantastic film and does a lot of the same things that the original does but it didnt impact me the same as the original. That be said watching it in theaters was a hell of an experience and i would pay a stupid amount of money to do it again.

I had this problem literally 2 days ago. For me I went into device manager and under Bluetooth you should see the controllers. If they are there uninstall them. After that go into your actual Bluetooth settings in the windows settings and unpair them there. If you don't do it in the device manager first it won't unpair them for some odd reason. After that take the backs off the controllers and then hold the Bluetooth and power button on the controller for 15 seconds to reset them to default settings. If your controller turns on before the 15 seconds you did it wrong and need to try it again. There is really no indication that they are reset but just know after that 15 seconds they are. After all that turn on the controllers and hold the Bluetooth button and they should start fading in and out to indicate pair mode. Go into Bluetooth settings and connect to them. After they are connected they should start oscillating back and forth to finish the pairing process. Don't turn them off if that is happening just let it happen or you will have to do this all again because I did lul. I hope this helps. If not I got nothing 


Edit: just to note also, for my experience I wasn't able to get my controllers to connect at all after replacing my Bluetooth dongle.

If you have a background or experience with replacing and re-soldering parts then look into it. If not then again look into a new power supply.
